rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for describing an action that looks easy and requires little effort.

example.english: They made doing the homework look effortless.
example.traditional: 佢做份功課做得好輕鬆。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 hou2 hing1 sung1

rows.note: Use this idiomatic expression when stressing that something is exceptionally easy to accomplish.

example.english: They made solving the difficult problem look effortless.
example.traditional: 佢輕而易舉咁解決咗個難題。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hing1 ji4 jik6 geoi2 gam3 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 go3 naan4 tai4

rows.note: Use this when the effortless quality specifically means that no physical force or exertion is needed.

example.english: Moving this plastic stool indoors was effortless.
example.traditional: 搬呢張膠凳返入屋完全唔使出力。
example.jyutping: bun1 ni1 zoeng1 gaau1 dang3 faan2 jap6 uk1 jyun4 cyun4 m4 sai2 ceot1 lik6
